result.description: Cloud customer support helpdesk (ticketing, contacts, companies, knowledge base, SLAs) by Freshworks.
result.auth_detail: API key (per agent, from Profile Settings) sent as HTTP Basic username with dummy password "X". No documented OAuth2 flow for the public REST API (Freshworks forum: Basic only). Per-account subdomain base URL.
result.access_detail: No Free plan API access (Free = 0 calls/min). Growth $19/agent/mo annual is the minimum paid tier; 14-day Enterprise trial gives 50 calls/min. Limits per account: Growth 100, Pro 400, Enterprise 700 calls/min. Self-serve signup, no app review for API-key use.
result.api_notes: REST v2 at https://{domain}.freshdesk.com/api/v2/. Resources: tickets, conversations, contacts, companies, agents, groups, solutions, discussions, time entries, SLA policies, automations, custom objects, service accounts, audit log, etc. HTTPS only; 429 on over-limit; webhooks count toward the limit.
result.blocker: Free plan has no API access; testing needs a paid plan or 14-day trial. API-key only (no OAuth), and the key is per-subdomain, so the user must supply their domain. Rate limits are low on Growth.

evidence.quote: MCP server created for Freshdesk, allowing AI models to interact with Freshdesk modules.
Freshdesk MCP uses API key authentication.
Only SSL calls (HTTPS) will be allowed.
For every trial period the API limit is 50 per minute.
When you sign up, you instantly get access to our Enterprise plan for 14 days.
MCP is supported only in Freshdesk 2021 and Freshdesk Unified Omni 2026.
The number of API calls you can make is based on your plan.
